q: What is the right to life and personal liberty?
must_contain: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty
Prime Minister shall be appointed by the President

q: How can the President be impeached?
must_contain: the charge shall be preferred by either House of Parliament

q: What is the term of office of the President?
must_contain: the president shall hold office for a term of five years

q: Who appoints the Governor of a State?
must_contain: The Governor of a State shall be appointed by the President
shall be elected by the members of an electoral college

q: What does the Constitution say about untouchability?
must_contain: its practice in any form is forbidden

q: Can children be employed in factories?
must_contain: shall be employed to work in any factory or mine

q: What is the right to education?
must_contain: free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years

q: What does Article 14 say about equality?
must_contain: shall not deny to any person equality before the law
